PR Summary by Qodo

Accept RSA and ECDSA SSH proxy host keys 🐞 Bug fix 🧪 Tests 🕐 10-20 Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Allow operator-supplied RSA and ECDSA host keys to reach the existing SSH signer.
>• Add regression tests for supported algorithms, signatures, public keys, and invalid input.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD A["Operator host key"] --> B["Base64 decoding"] --> C["OpenSSH parser"] --> D["SSH signer"] --> E["Password server"] D --> F["Certificate server"] ```
High-Level Assessment

>Returning the parser's key directly is the smallest appropriate change: the existing SSH signer already handles supported key types. Adding algorithm-specific decoding paths would duplicate that behavior; Ed25519-only automatic key generation remains unchanged.
Files changed (2) +69 / -16

Bug fix (1) +2 / -11
keys.goRemove the Ed25519-only private-key assertion +2/-11
>Remove the Ed25519-only private-key assertion > >
>• The decoder now returns the OpenSSH parser's private key directly, allowing the existing signer to accept supported RSA and ECDSA keys as well as Ed25519. Ed25519 key encoding is unchanged.
>
> >gateway/proxyproto/sshproxy/keys.go
Tests (1) +67 / -5
keys_test.goCover host-key algorithms and invalid input +67/-5
>Cover host-key algorithms and invalid input > >
>• Adds OpenSSH key tests for Ed25519, ECDSA P-256 and P-384, and RSA-3072, checking signer creation, public-key preservation, and signature verification. The existing round-trip test now asserts the parsed Ed25519 pointer type, and a new test rejects invalid input.
>
